# See docs/capability-profiles.md §4.2
id: executor.code@1.0.0
class: executor
version: 1.0.0
description: |
  Code-editing executor. Runs only via approved HandoffPacket.
  Can edit repo, run shell + builds + tests, create/commit (local) branches.
  Cannot push, tag, deploy, publish, or write connectors.

tool_allow:
  - read_file
  - list_directory
  - glob
  - grep
  - edit_file
  - write_file
  - delete_file
  - move_file
  - shell.exec
  - shell.exec_allowlisted
  - git_log
  - git_show
  - git_diff
  - git_branch_create
  - git_commit
  - test.run
  - lint.run
  - build.run
  - format.run
  - package_manager.*
  - connector.read.*

tool_deny:
  - git_push
  - git_tag
  - deploy.*
  - publish.*
  - db.migrate.*
  - db.backfill.*
  - connector.write.*

shell_allowlist: []

fs:
  read: project_root
  write: project_root
  deny_globs:
    - ".env*"
    - "**/secrets/**"
    - "**/.git/config"
    - "**/.aws/**"
    - "**/.ssh/**"
  max_bytes_per_read: 10485760
  max_bytes_per_write: 5242880

git:
  read: true
  branch: true
  commit: true
  tag: false
  push: false
  protected_refs: [main, master, "release/*", prod]

connectors:
  read: [github, notion, linear, figma]
  write: []

network_egress:
  mode: allowlist
  host_allowlist:
    - registry.npmjs.org
    - pypi.org
    - crates.io
    - proxy.golang.org
    - github.com
    - api.github.com
  methods_allow: [GET, HEAD, POST]

approval_required_for:
  - git.branch.create_from_protected
  - delete_file
  - move_file
  - shell.exec

# Stage X.2 — agent-kind compatibility. executor.code is the canonical
# Build/Handoff executor and is the only profile cleared for ACP
# (Claude Code / OpenCode / Codex) initially.
allowed_agent_kinds:
  - mock
  - vac-native
  - acp

resource_limits:
  max_session_wallclock_ms: 7200000
  max_tool_calls: 5000
  max_concurrent_children: 8

audit:
  log_every_tool_call: true
  log_tool_args: full
  retain_for_days: 90
